question: Does a July-selected pooled regression forecast improve weekday 18:00 zone net trip flow over a July-selected seasonal/rolling comparator in an additional fixed three-month period?

inspection_status.january_june: Original study already inspected; reconstructed daily panel is development data.
inspection_status.july: Previously inspected one-month mean-versus-zero result. July is explicitly development/model selection here; it is not a new holdout.
inspection_status.august_october: No outcomes, file contents, row counts or forecasting scores inspected before registration. Official website links were resolved; the web reader rejected three binary links as unsupported content-type, without supplying their data. No local Parquet download occurred.
inspection_status.registration: Publish protocol, executable methods and tests before source collection; publish July selection lock before locally downloading/reconstructing August-October. Retrospective work executed in October 2026, not a prospective 2025 trial.

universe: Exactly the original 261 LocationIDs, all calendar weekdays including holidays, every zone-date including zero activity. No future activation/zone selection. Report any activity outside this frozen universe.
target: Local source wall-clock 18:00-18:59:59 pickup/dropoff event counts; net_flow = dropoffs - pickups. This is signed trip flow, not idle supply or unmet demand.
cleaning: Original strict rule: nonnull pickup/dropoff, pickup in registered block, IDs 1..263, 0 < trip_distance < 100, dropoff > pickup, floor(elapsed seconds)/60 between 1 and 240. Jan-Jun files jointly restricted to Jan-Jun exactly as original; July and each evaluation file restricted to its own pickup month. The <=4-hour duration bound prevents prior-month pickups contributing next-month 18:00 dropoffs. Source timestamps are treated as local wall-clock; no timezone conversion.

availability.scenario: Retrospective operator-feed simulation: at each weekday forecast origin, the previous weekday's complete 18:00 net-flow panel is assumed available by 00:00 local time on the target date. All features use strictly earlier dates; no same-day pickups, dropoffs or weather.
availability.warning: TLC publishes monthly, typically with a two-month delay. This daily feed is an assumption, not supplied or verified by TLC. No public-release-feasible backtest, original-vintage/PIT claim or deployment claim. Both June model fitting and July selection/refitting require the assumed operator feed.
availability.parameters: Candidate model parameters fit through June for July selection; chosen ridge and boosting refit once through July. Parameters are then fixed throughout August-October; rolling history updates are allowed only after the observation date.

baseline_selection: Lowest July full-panel MAE among seven nonzero baselines; lexicographic name breaks exact ties. Zero is a sanity comparison only. Report all eight evaluation comparators, never change the primary comparator based on evaluation.
feature_rules: First 20 prior weekdays and at least four prior same weekdays required; supervised fits start February 3. Historical aggregates are recomputed exclusively from prior observations for each training/selection/evaluation row. No numeric LocationID, current target, fare, current pickup/dropoff totals or future calendar-event realization enters X. Day-of-year and weekday are known calendar features; holidays remain scored, without post-hoc exclusions.

models.budget: Six total candidates, three per family, identical development rows/features; no random split/early-stopping evaluation. Select best July MAE within each family, then the primary advanced winner across both by July MAE/name. Refit only those two selected configurations through July once. Do not test the other four configurations on the final period.

metrics.primary: MAE on every evaluation zone-date; selected advanced minus selected nonzero baseline
metrics.high_activity_rule: Largest ceil(0.2 * 261) zones by January-June mean pickups+dropoffs; deterministic LocationID tie break. Fixed before July selection and final scoring.

methods: Paired ISO-calendar-week cluster bootstrap retaining all zones/dates in sampled weeks
Paired zone cluster bootstrap retaining all dates in sampled zones
uncertainty.limitations: Separate fixed-fit conditional sensitivity intervals, not joint time-space dependence, independent years, model-refit or July model-selection uncertainty. Retain partial weeks and all dates.

source.replay: Retain raw byte SHA256, file bytes, collection timestamp and block cleaning counts; commit lossless complete daily panels; remote raw reconstruction must fetch pinned official Parquet and recover identical counts/panels. Do not redistribute raw trip records.

interpretation: Stronger temporal forecasting check within the same transport family. No live dispatch execution, idle-vehicle observation, causal cost saving, external adoption, frontier/SOTA claim or global optimality. Original 3.76% static proxy-distance optimum/greedy result and the inspected July result remain separate and unchanged.
